description: During the 2026-04-23 vision walk decision IDs like dec-1776896266693850072 were read aloud by the TTS as giant cardinal numbers ("one quadrillion...") which is unusable. The TTS preprocessor must not pronounce numbers inside code ticks (`...`), and should treat strings matching obvious ID patterns such as \w+-\d{10,} as character-by-character read or skip entirely. Fix scope: update the TTS preprocessor to (a) skip / character-read content inside backtick or code-block spans; (b) detect common ID patterns outside code ticks and apply the same rule; (c) include a test case for the literal dec-<timestamp> pattern used across prompt-manager decisions.
name: web-console-tts-code-tick-handling
title: Web Console TTS Must Not Pronounce Numbers Inside Code Ticks Or ID Patterns
